plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. While collusion or game theory could suggest other approaches, with only one round and no prior knowledge of the other bidders' strategies, bidding my value maximizes my expected utility. There is no opportunity to learn from past rounds. Therefore, I will bid exactly my value, $27.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks winning the auction but paying more than the item is worth to you. My value is $31, so I will bid that amount.
